title: Innovative multi-layered Fe3O4-Gr/carbon/polypyrrole nanofiber composite: “a new frontier in dielectric enhancement and EMI shielding”
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37483-37497
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06928E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ujala Anwar, Muhammad Rafi, Naveed A. Noor, Sadia Nazir, Sohail Mumtaz, Ihab Mohamed Moussa
This study presents the synthesis and comprehensive characterization of an Fe3O4-Gr/carbon/polypyrrole nanofiber composite, highlighting its morphology, as determined through Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscopy (FE-SEM) analysis.
